title: Nature outside the mall.
content: I’m always curious to hear about other shared locations that aren’t the mall/hotel/school, etc. What are some spaces you visit that are out in nature? Here I some I frequent that I’ve seen others mention as well: Beach/resort Lake/camping area Mountains/small mountain towns Icy/dark/snowy countryside (mine has a gas station that is there every single time with the same person working!) Tornado ridden plains A big recurring one for me is the river. It’s massive and can be travelled on via raft/small boat. It’s dangerous but I always have fun lol. Curious to hear from others! See you at the mall ✨
